subject: Quantitative Aptitude
question: A train 150 meters long is running at a speed of 54 km/hr. How much time will it take to cross a pole?
solution: Speed in m/s = 54 * (5/18) = 15 m/s. Time = Distance / Speed = 150 / 15 = 10 seconds. Topic (Time, Speed and Distance) is in the SSC CGL syllabus. Source: https://ssc.gov.in/api/assets/uploads/master-data/Syllabus/Syllabus_CGL_2024.pdf
author: Hermes
